analysis.session_summary: Friday's NFP miss printed 29K vs 89K forecast, initially selling USD by 0.097%, but USD selling was rejected and recovered 90% of its intraday loss. EUR was the weakest major despite a muted CPI beat, closing with strength at -0.413%, while AUD led at 0.266%. The tape shows a late USD bid into the weekend/Asia reopen; VIX fell 0.854% while DXY rose 0.455%.

themes.evidence: NFP miss printed 29K vs 89K; USD sold 0.097% then recovered 90% and DXY closed +0.455%.
AUD strength 0.266%, NZD -0.204%, CAD -0.283%; AUD/NZD +0.47% and USD/CAD +0.497%.

themes.theme: Energy release headlines without FX follow-through
themes.evidence: Top headlines on IEA/diesel releases, Kihara oil reserves, and OPEC+ delays; most FX legs had no single trigger assigned.

currency_drivers.NZD: No own releases; held weak range at -0.204% strength.

leg_notes.EUR/USD: EUR/USD fell 25.8 pips before NFP, spiked +57.6 on the payrolls miss, then retraced -100.3 to close near lows; EUR weakness contributed 66% of the pair move.

polarity_reads.read: Normal polarity: miss weakened USD; Gold +0.866% and USD/JPY -0.292% show the initial USD dip was faded, consistent with crowded short-USD positioning.
Muted polarity: EUR basket moved -0.036% inside the noise floor despite 3.8% actual versus 3.7% forecast, showing EUR could not rally on a beat.
